long_biography.plain_text:
Ömer Sabancı entered the family conglomerate through manufacturing rather than remaining only a shareholder. He spent fifteen years as general manager and chairman of SASA, later led Sabancı's chemicals group and served on the holding company's board. That operating career accompanied inherited interests in Sabancı Holding and Akbank, keeping personal management distinct from passive family ownership.

After leaving the holding company's board, Sabancı co-founded Densa Shipping and became chairman of Densa Holding. The new platform expanded rapidly through dry-bulk carriers and tankers, establishing shipping as his clearest later operating focus. He also chaired TÜSİAD from 2004 to 2006. His current personal percentages across the family holding, bank and Densa entities remain private.
